Add latitude and longitude fields to Location model (#357)

* drop postgres

* Add latitude and longitude fields to Location model

Implements ADR 0003 (geocoding without SpatiaLite) by adding simple
latitude/longitude DecimalField fields to the Location model instead
of using spatial database extensions.

Changes:
- Add latitude/longitude fields to Location model (DecimalField)
- Create migration 0037: Add nullable lat/lng fields
- Create migration 0038: Populate from google_maps_response JSON
- Create migration 0039: Make fields required
- Update google_maps facade to return lat/lng from API
- Update LocationAdmin to display and save lat/lng fields
- Update fixtures with populated latitude/longitude values

This approach maintains simplicity for contributors while supporting
the geocoding use case for finding nearby parishes and schedules.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Update ADR 0003 with DecimalField precision details

Add technical documentation about coordinate precision:
- Clarify using DecimalField (not float) for lat/lng
- Explain why DecimalField over FloatField (exact decimal precision, no floating-point errors)
- Document max_digits and decimal_places for each field
- Explain 8 decimal places = ~1.1mm worst-case precision
- Note that precision improves at higher latitudes

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

This reverts commit d03352d6bda2af73484b024c027afcf16171ecbb.

* squashmigrations

* Update missas/core/migrations/0037_add_latitude_longitude_to_location_squashed_0039_make_latitude_longitude_required.py

@@ -20,7 +20,11 @@ The geocoding use case for the project will be modest: Find nearby parishes and
 
 Instead, we will:
 
-- Store coordinates as simple `latitude` and `longitude` float fields.
+- Store coordinates as simple `latitude` and `longitude` DecimalField fields.
+  - `latitude`: DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=8) - supports ±90° with 8 decimal places
+  - `longitude`: DecimalField(max_digits=11, decimal_places=8) - supports ±180° with 8 decimal places
+  - **Why DecimalField instead of FloatField**: DecimalField provides exact decimal precision without floating-point rounding errors, ensuring consistent and predictable coordinate values. This is important for geographic coordinates where we need exact representation of values like -5.94734080.
+  - **Precision**: 8 decimal places provides approximately 1.1mm accuracy (worst case at the equator; better precision at higher latitudes). This is more than sufficient for locating parishes.
 - Perform distance calculations in Python (e.g., Haversine or approximate deltas).
 - Filter and sort in Python after querying only nearby rows.
 - Enforce a maximum radius in the API to avoid returning excessive data.

+# Generated by Django 5.2.7 on 2025-11-16 22:05
+
+from django.db import migrations, models
+
+
+def populate_latitude_longitude(apps, schema_editor):
+    Location = apps.get_model("core", "Location")
+    db_alias = schema_editor.connection.alias
+
+    for location in Location.objects.using(db_alias).all():
+        first_result = location.google_maps_response["results"][0]
+        geometry = first_result["geometry"]["location"]
+        location.latitude = geometry["lat"]
+        location.longitude = geometry["lng"]
+        location.save(using=db_alias, update_fields=["latitude", "longitude"])
+
+
+def reverse_populate_latitude_longitude(apps, schema_editor):
+    Location = apps.get_model("core", "Location")
+    db_alias = schema_editor.connection.alias
+
+    for location in Location.objects.using(db_alias).all():
+        location.latitude = None
+        location.longitude = None
+        location.save(using=db_alias, update_fields=["latitude", "longitude"])
+
+
+class Migration(migrations.Migration):
+
+    dependencies = [
+        (
+            "core",
+            "0032_add_google_place_id_to_location_squashed_0036_rename_google_place_id_location_google_maps_place_id",
+        ),
+    ]
+
+    operations = [
+        migrations.AddField(
+            model_name="location",
+            name="latitude",
+            field=models.DecimalField(
+                blank=True, decimal_places=8, max_digits=10, null=True
+            ),
+        ),
+        migrations.AddField(
+            model_name="location",
+            name="longitude",
+            field=models.DecimalField(
+                blank=True, decimal_places=8, max_digits=11, null=True
+            ),
+        ),
+        migrations.RunPython(
+            code=populate_latitude_longitude,
+            reverse_code=reverse_populate_latitude_longitude,
+        ),
+        migrations.AlterField(
+            model_name="location",
+            name="latitude",
+            field=models.DecimalField(decimal_places=8, max_digits=10),
+        ),
+        migrations.AlterField(
+            model_name="location",
+            name="longitude",
+            field=models.DecimalField(decimal_places=8, max_digits=11),
+        ),
+    ]
